title: Grateful Dead Live at Cumberland County Civic Center on 1982-09-17
source: Source Info: Jim Wise's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 421 mics > Sony TC-D5 (Maxell XLII-S); Transfer Info: Master Cassettes (Nakamichi Dragon)> Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz) > dBpoweramp (24-bit/96 kHz) > Adobe Audition 3.01 (24-bit/96 kHz) > TLH flac2496

ai_review.summary: Excellent front‑of‑house capture with crystal‑clear soundboard mix, though Brent's keyboard mic is missing, delivering a stellar performance.
ai_review.review: The reviewer rates both the setlist and the audio five stars, calling this FO B recording as good as it gets. The sound quality is described as flawless, aside from the unusual lack of a microphone for Brent which eliminates his background vocals. Overall the show is praised as a must‑hear experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Single detailed five‑star review highlights an outstanding performance and excellent recording quality, with only one minor technical omission (missing Brent mic).

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp front‑of‑house mix; no microphone set up for Brent on this night, resulting in missing background vocals.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewer gives the entire setlist five stars and says it will not disappoint first‑time listeners.

band_member_comments.Keys: No microphone was set up for Brent, so his keyboard parts lack vocal presence.
